hxcolumnheader.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit column header API. The column header widget is used by the File Manager application and by the file dialogs, and allows the application to define buttons at the top of multi-column extended lists.

HxResult HxColumnHeaderAddColumn ( HxColumnHeader_t *  pColumnHeader,
const char *  pTitle,
int32_t  width,
int32_t  offset 
)

Add a column to a column header.

The offset argument determines the gap between adjacent columns. Normally, applications should set this argument to kHxColumnHeaderDefaultTextOffset.

If the column is the last column, and if it should extend to the end of the header, its width should be set to kHxColumnHeaderUseRemainingWidth.

Parameters:
pColumnHeader IN: Pointer to column header
pTitle IN: Column's title
width IN: Width of the column
offset IN: Column title offset
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxColumnHeaderDelete ( HxColumnHeader_t *  pColumnHeader  ) 

Delete a column header widget.

HxColumnHeaderDelete deletes a widget created from an earlier call to HxColumnHeaderNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxColumnHeaderDelete only needs to be called when removing a widget at runtime.

Parameters:
pColumnHeader IN: Pointer to the widget to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.
